Date rules

Connected activities may share a day, but a successor cannot be dated before its predecessor. An action with no target sits at its trigger date and is not overdue. A target or completion cannot be before its trigger. Editing a visible date shifts later unfinished actions’ dates by the same number of days; original target dates and completed records stay fixed.
